current_suggestion.pitch: Your poker channels cover GTO theory well but none give serious attention to the behavioral and cognitive science of decision-making under uncertainty at the table — Phil Hellmuth's mindset failures, tilt, and opponent modeling. Nate Meyvis and Tom Crowley on Thinking Poker come closest but their format is episode-based. A strong complement is 'Smart Poker Study' with Sky Matsuhashi, who covers hand history review, study methodology, and deliberate practice frameworks for poker improvement — the meta-skill of how to actually get better, not just what the solver says.
